- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by running the app and observing behavior. Use when asked to verify a PR, confirm a fix works, test a change manually, check that a feature works, or validate local changes before pushing.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

1	import { pgTable, text, serial, timestamp, integer, boolean, numeric, uniqueIndex, index } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
2	import { courtsTable } from "./courts";
3	
4	export const coachesTable = pgTable("coaches", {
5	  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
6	  userId: text("user_id").notNull().unique(),
7	  name: text("name").notNull(),
8	  email: text("email").notNull(),
9	  bio: text("bio"),
10	  photoUrl: text("photo_url"),
11	  videoUrl: text("video_url"),
12	  // Hourly rate stored as integer cents — aligns with Stripe and avoids
13	  // floating-point drift in financial math. UI must divide by 100 on display
14	  // and multiply by 100 on submit.
15	  pricePerHour: integer("price_per_hour"),
16	  sports: text("sports").array().notNull().default([]),
17	  availabilityDescription: text("availability_description"),
18	  phone: text("phone"),
19	  isAcceptingStudents: boolean("is_accepting_students").notNull().default(true),
20	  experienceYears: integer("experience_years"),
21	  qualifications: text("qualifications").array().notNull().default([]),
22	  // travelPolicy: 'any_court' (free-agent, can teach anywhere) or
23	  // 'affiliated_only' (only at courts they have an approved partnership with).
24	  travelPolicy: text("travel_policy").notNull().default("affiliated_only"),
25	  // courtPaymentModel: 'student_pays_court' (student books the court directly,
26	  // coach earns lesson fee only) or 'coach_pays_court' (coach books and bills
27	  // student a combined rate, then pays the court out of their fee).
28	  courtPaymentModel: text("court_payment_model").notNull().default("student_pays_court"),
29	  // cancellationPolicy: per-coach refund policy applied INDEPENDENTLY of the
30	  // court's policy. Values:
31	  //   'flexible' — 100% up to 24h before start, 0% inside 24h
32	  //   'standard' — 80% > 48h, 50% > 24h, 0% inside 24h
33	  //   'strict'   — 0% at any time
34	  cancellationPolicy: text("cancellation_policy").notNull().default("standard"),
35	  status: text("status").notNull().default("pending"),
36	  rejectionReason: text("rejection_reason"),
37	  // Denormalized review aggregates (Invariant D — kept in sync by
38	  // syncCoachAverageRating on every reviews insert/update/delete). The
39	  // marketplace list query reads these directly to avoid a per-coach
40	  // sub-aggregate. Nullable averageRating signals "no reviews yet".
41	  averageRating: numeric("average_rating", { precision: 3, scale: 2 }),
42	  reviewCount: integer("review_count").notNull().default(0),
43	  promotedUntil: timestamp("promoted_until", { withTimezone: true }),
44	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
45	});
46	
47	export const courtCoachesTable = pgTable("court_coaches", {
48	  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
49	  courtId: integer("court_id").notNull().references(() => courtsTable.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
50	  coachId: integer("coach_id").notNull().references(() => coachesTable.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
51	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
52	}, (t) => ({
53	  uniqCourtCoach: uniqueIndex("court_coaches_court_id_coach_id_unique").on(t.courtId, t.coachId),
54	}));
55	
56	export const courtCoachInvitationsTable = pgTable("court_coach_invitations", {
57	  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
58	  courtId: integer("court_id").notNull().references(() => courtsTable.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
59	  targetUserId: text("target_user_id"),
60	  targetEmail: text("target_email"),
61	  targetName: text("target_name"),
62	  initiatedBy: text("initiated_by").notNull().default("owner"),
63	  status: text("status").notNull().default("pending"),
64	  message: text("message"),
65	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
66	});
67	
68	/**
69	 * Recurring weekly availability for a coach. One row per (coachId, dayOfWeek,
70	 * startTime, endTime) — coaches with split schedules (e.g. 09:00–12:00 and
71	 * 16:00–20:00 on Mondays) get multiple rows for the same day. Times are
72	 * stored as HH:MM strings interpreted in Europe/Vilnius local time so DST
73	 * shifts don't move a coach's working hours twice a year.
74	 */
75	export const coachAvailabilitiesTable = pgTable("coach_availabilities", {
76	  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
77	  coachId: integer("coach_id").notNull().references(() => coachesTable.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
78	  dayOfWeek: integer("day_of_week").notNull(), // 0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday
79	  startTime: text("start_time").notNull(), // "HH:MM"
80	  endTime: text("end_time").notNull(),     // "HH:MM"
81	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
82	}, (t) => ({
83	  byCoachDay: index("coach_availabilities_coach_day_idx").on(t.coachId, t.dayOfWeek),
84	}));
85	
86	/**
87	 * One-off blocks (vacations, conflicts) overriding the recurring schedule.
88	 * Stored as absolute UTC timestamps so range comparisons work without
89	 * timezone gymnastics. The UI converts to Europe/Vilnius for display.
90	 */
91	export const coachBlockedSlotsTable = pgTable("coach_blocked_slots", {
92	  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
93	  coachId: integer("coach_id").notNull().references(() => coachesTable.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
94	  startTime: timestamp("start_time", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
95	  endTime: timestamp("end_time", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
96	  reason: text("reason"),
97	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
98	}, (t) => ({
99	  byCoachStart: index("coach_blocked_slots_coach_start_idx").on(t.coachId, t.startTime),
100	}));
101	
102	/**
103	 * Per-sport target audiences. Stored as a junction table (not a flat array
104	 * on `coaches`) so a coach can declare "I teach kids tennis but only adults
105	 * for swimming" without cross-pollinating the audience tags. The marketplace
106	 * filter joins on (sport, audience) — flattening would cause false-positive
107	 * search matches when a coach teaches multiple sports for different levels.
108	 *
109	 * One row per (coachId, sport). The `audiences` column is a Postgres text[]
110	 * holding the wizard's checkboxes: 'kids' | 'beginners' | 'advanced' | 'pros'.
111	 */
112	export const coachSportsTable = pgTable("coach_sports", {
113	  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
114	  coachId: integer("coach_id").notNull().references(() => coachesTable.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
115	  sport: text("sport").notNull(),
116	  audiences: text("audiences").array().notNull().default([]),
117	}, (t) => ({
118	  uniqCoachSport: uniqueIndex("coach_sports_coach_sport_unique").on(t.coachId, t.sport),
119	  byCoach: index("coach_sports_coach_idx").on(t.coachId),
120	}));
121	
122	/**
123	 * Bookable services offered by a coach (motifind-style "service rows").
124	 * A coach has ONE shared availability schedule but MANY services, each with
125	 * its own price, duration, group size, and optional court binding.
126	 *
127	 * Invariant B (historical immutability): priceCents is the ground truth for
128	 * the Stripe charge AT THE MOMENT a booking is created. Once a booking row
129	 * exists, bookings.coachAmountCents is snapshotted and never recomputed
130	 * even if priceCents later changes.
131	 *
132	 * Invariant A (denormalized price sync): coachesTable.pricePerHour is kept
133	 * in sync as the lowest active hourly rate across this coach's services
134	 * (computed as priceCents * 60 / durationMin). Updates to this table must
135	 * trigger that recomputation on the server side.
136	 */
137	export const coachServicesTable = pgTable("coach_services", {
138	  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
139	  coachId: integer("coach_id").notNull().references(() => coachesTable.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
140	  name: text("name").notNull(),
141	  description: text("description"),
142	  sport: text("sport").notNull(),
143	  // Optional binding to a specific court. When set, this service is bookable
144	  // only at that court. When null, the customer picks among the coach's
145	  // affiliated courts at booking time.
146	  courtId: integer("court_id").references(() => courtsTable.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
147	  durationMin: integer("duration_min").notNull().default(60),
148	  priceCents: integer("price_cents").notNull(),
149	  maxParticipants: integer("max_participants").notNull().default(1),
150	  // Optional target audience for this specific service (e.g. a coach may
151	  // teach all levels but offer a service explicitly for kids).
152	  audienceLevel: text("audience_level"),
153	  isActive: boolean("is_active").notNull().default(true),
154	  sortOrder: integer("sort_order").notNull().default(0),
155	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
156	  updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
157	}, (t) => ({
158	  byCoach: index("coach_services_coach_idx").on(t.coachId, t.isActive),
159	}));
160	
161	export type Coach = typeof coachesTable.$inferSelect;
162	export type CourtCoach = typeof courtCoachesTable.$inferSelect;
163	export type CourtCoachInvitation = typeof courtCoachInvitationsTable.$inferSelect;
164	export type CoachAvailability = typeof coachAvailabilitiesTable.$inferSelect;
165	export type CoachBlockedSlot = typeof coachBlockedSlotsTable.$inferSelect;
166	export type CoachSport = typeof coachSportsTable.$inferSelect;
167	export type CoachService = typeof coachServicesTable.$inferSelect;
168
